instruction: Show me the schedule for Week 1 of the 2023 NFL season.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating from NFL.com homepage to the Week 1 schedule for 2023 season. Similar complexity to original - simple navigation. Uses is_expected_url_pattern_match metric with regex pattern to verify the URL contains season year (2023) and week designation (REG1).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active URL from accessibility tree for Chrome navigation verification
Metric properly uses regex pattern matching to verify URL contains correct NFL schedule path with year (2023) and week identifier (REG1)
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction (navigate to Week 1 2023 NFL schedule)
Expected regex pattern is semantically correct and properly escaped (https://www\.nfl\.com/schedules/2023/REG1)
Data flow is correct: getter returns string URL, metric accepts string or dict with 'url' field, pattern list is correctly structured
No postconfig needed as URL verification doesn't depend on UI state
Metric implementation correctly iterates through pattern list and uses re.search() for matching
